items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I once went out with a guy named Al Sky [Al Skoin] and His Musical Stars and I toured---

ctx.x: And, you had this old stove in there---

Yeah - it went once and we almost upset--- I kicked--- it was a gasoline stove and I opened the door and kicked it out into the snow and it's a good thing we did because it blew up later. And, that would have been the end of us--- you know, those early trailers were made out of some kind of oilcloth on the outside -- they were just wooden strips holding it together on the inside--- and, I couldn't take him very much--- I stayed with it as long as I could - as long as I could and when we got to Grand Island,…
And you just--- from that point on, for the next several years, you had your---it always was your band---
